name: Core Platform
description: Apex, SOQL/SOSL, LWC, Triggers, Flows, Governor Limits & Security
architecturalStandards: Apex Enterprise Patterns (fflib / TriggerHandler), Bulkification, LDS Caching, Transaction Control, Sharing & Visibility (WITH USER_MODE, stripInaccessible)
instructions:
Core Platform: Official Salesforce Architecture & Standards.
- Apex: Master of Trigger frameworks (One trigger per object, TriggerHandler, recursion prevention via static Set<Id>), Asynchronous Apex (@future for simple callouts, Queueable for sObjects/chaining/Finalizers, Batchable for up to 50M records with 5 concurrent jobs, Schedulable).
- SOQL: Aggregate queries (COUNT, SUM, AVG, GROUP BY, HAVING), relationship queries (parent-to-child subqueries, child-to-parent lookups), custom indexing awareness (standard indexed: Id, Name, OwnerId, CreatedDate, RecordType, Lookups/Master-Detail).
- LWC: Lightning Web Components (Shadow DOM, @api public props/methods, @wire reactive adapters with LDS client-side caching, Custom Events with bubbles/composed).
- Governor Limits: 100 SOQL sync / 200 async, 50,000 SOQL rows, 150 DML statements, 10,000 DML rows, 6MB heap sync / 12MB async, 10s CPU sync / 60s async.
- Security: with sharing (record sharing), WITHOUT sharing, inherited sharing, Security.stripInaccessible(), WITH USER_MODE for FLS and object CRUD enforcement.

name: Agentforce (Atlas)
description: Atlas Reasoning Engine, Topics, Invocable Actions, Trust Layer & Agent API
architecturalStandards: Atlas ReAct Planning Loop (Reason -> Act -> Observe), Semantic Intent Topic Classification, Invocable Apex Action Grounding, Einstein Trust Layer ZDR & PII Masking
instructions:
Agentforce: Official Salesforce Winter '27 & Agentblazer Architecture.
- Atlas Reasoning Engine: Autonomous orchestrator utilizing the ReAct (Reason, Act, Observe) loop. Evaluates conversation history, determines semantic intent, selects candidate Topics, executes Tools/Actions, and iteratively verifies task completion.
- Topics: Replace monolithic system prompts with modular operational domains defined by crisp natural-language descriptions that Atlas uses as classification boundaries.
- Actions: Tools executable by Atlas including Apex @InvocableMethod (strongly typed @InvocableVariable parameters, description engineering for tool calling, structured error reporting), Autolaunched Flows, Prompt Templates, and MuleSoft APIs.
- Einstein Trust Layer: Real-time dynamic PII masking, Zero Data Retention (ZDR) guarantee with external LLMs, toxicity scoring, hallucination mitigation, and audit logging.
- Grounding & Models: Dynamic grounding in Prompt Builder via Data Cloud Data Graphs, Model Builder BYO-LLM integrations, and programmatic execution via Agent API & Models API.

name: Data Cloud
description: Customer 360, Data Streams, DLO, DMO (__dlm), Identity Resolution & Zero Copy
architecturalStandards: Cloud Information Model (CIM), DLO (__dll) to DMO (__dlm) mapping, Deterministic/Probabilistic Identity Resolution, Calculated Insights (Spark/Flink), Data Graphs, Zero Copy Iceberg
instructions:
Data Cloud: Official Customer 360 & Data 360 Architecture.
- Ingestion & Storage: Ingestion via Data Streams (CRM, S3, Ingestion API, Web/Mobile SDKs). Staged into Data Lake Objects (DLOs ending in `__dll`), then harmonized into standard Data Model Objects (DMOs ending in `__dlm`) aligned with the Cloud Information Model (CIM).
- Data Spaces: Logical partitions providing multi-tenant and business unit data isolation.
- Identity Resolution: Ruleset engine combining Deterministic matching (exact match on normalized email, phone, Party ID) and Probabilistic matching (ML fuzzy match on Name + Address). Reconciliation rules (Last Modified, Most Frequent, Source Priority) create Unified Individual and Unified Link records.
- Calculated Insights (CI): Complex multidimensional metrics (CLV, RFM, churn risk) executed via Apache Spark (batch) or Apache Flink (streaming).
- Data Graphs: Materialized hierarchical JSON views pre-joining multiple DMOs for sub-second retrieval by Agentforce and external APIs.
- Hybrid Search & Vector DB: Unstructured data chunking, embeddings, and Hybrid RAG combining BM25 keyword search + Cosine vector similarity via Reciprocal Rank Fusion (RRF).
- Zero Copy: Bi-directional storage federation via Apache Iceberg/Delta Lake with Snowflake, Google BigQuery, AWS Redshift, and Databricks without ETL.

name: Sales Cloud
description: Leads, Opportunities, Pipeline, Forecasting, Products, CPQ & Territory Mgmt
architecturalStandards: Lead Conversion Lifecycle, Collaborative Forecasting, Multi-Currency (ACM), Enterprise Territory Management, CPQ Product/Price Rules & Contracting
instructions:
Sales Cloud: Official Sales Cloud Architecture & Standards.
- Lead Lifecycle: Web-to-Lead, Lead Assignment Rules, Lead Scoring, and transactional conversion mapping to Account, Contact, and Opportunity.
- Opportunity & Pipeline: Stage probability, Forecast Categories (Pipeline, Best Case, Commit, Closed, Omitted), Pipeline Inspection, and Advanced Currency Management (ACM).
- Products & Pricing: Product2, standard vs custom Pricebook2, PricebookEntry, and OpportunityLineItem scheduling.
- Splits & Territories: Revenue Splits (100% cap) vs Overlay Splits (>100%), Enterprise Territory Management (Territory2, rule-based account assignments).
- Salesforce CPQ: Product Bundles (Features, Options), Product Rules (Validation, Selection, Filter), Price Rules (Price Actions, Formulas), Quote Lines, Orders, Contracts, Subscriptions, and Assets.

name: Service Cloud
description: Cases, Omni-Channel, Entitlements/Milestones, Knowledge & Service Console
architecturalStandards: Case Lifecycle & Assignment, Omni-Channel Queue/Skills Routing, Entitlements & SLA Milestones, Knowledge Versioning & Data Categories, Service Console Tabs
instructions:
Service Cloud: Official Service Cloud Architecture & Standards.
- Case Management: Web-to-Case, Email-to-Case (routing addresses, threading token vs header-based threading), Case Assignment Rules, Auto-Response Rules, and Escalation Rules.
- Omni-Channel: Queue-Based vs Skills-Based routing models, routing priority (Most Available vs Least Active), capacity models (Percentage-based vs Tab-based), Presence Statuses, and Omni-Channel Supervisor.
- Entitlements & Milestones: Support contracts (Entitlement), SLA processes (SlaProcess), Milestones (First Response, Resolution Time), Milestone Triggers (Warning, Violation, Success actions).
- Salesforce Knowledge: KnowledgeArticleVersion lifecycle (Draft, Published, Archived), Data Categories and Category Groups for article access, channel visibility (Internal, Partner, Customer, Public).
- Service Console: Multi-tab workspace, subtab navigation, Workspace API (LWC lightning/consoleWorkspaceApi), Utility Bar widgets (Macros, History, CTI softphone).

name: Experience Cloud
description: Digital Experiences (Communities), LWR, Customer/Partner Portals & Security
architecturalStandards: LWR (Lightning Web Runtime) JAMstack Architecture, Sharing Sets & Share Groups, Customer/Partner Community License Hierarchy, Guest User Security
instructions:
Experience Cloud: Official Experience Cloud & Portal Architecture.
- Frameworks: Lightning Web Runtime (LWR) - modern, high-performance, edge-rendered JAMstack architecture using LWC without Aura overhead. Aura/Customer Service templates for classic community requirements.
- Licenses: Customer Community (high-volume, no role hierarchy, relies on Sharing Sets), Customer Community Plus (supports roles, standard sharing rules, reports/dashboards), Partner Community (adds Leads, Opportunities, Deal Registration).
- Security & Sharing: Guest User Security Policy (strictly private OWD, no edit/delete, no queue membership, uses Guest User Sharing Rules), Sharing Sets (grants portal users access by matching Account/Contact lookups), and Share Groups (grants internal users access to records owned by high-volume portal users).

name: Field Service (FSL / SFS)
description: Work Orders, Service Appointments, Dispatcher Console, Scheduling & Mobile
architecturalStandards: Work Order Lifecycle, Dispatcher Console Gantt View, Dynamic Scheduling Engine (Work Rules + Service Objectives = Scheduling Policy), Offline Mobile Briefcase
instructions:
Field Service (FSL / SFS): Official Field Service Architecture & Standards.
- Core Objects: WorkOrder, WorkOrderLineItem, ServiceAppointment (duration, scheduled/actual start/end, status transitions), ServiceResource (technician/crew linked to User, skills, absences), ServiceTerritory, OperatingHours & TimeSlots.
- Dispatcher Console: Gantt view, appointment status indicators, rule violation flags, multi-day scheduling, and manual drag-and-drop dispatching.
- Scheduling & Optimization Engine: Scheduling Policies composed of Work Rules (hard constraints: Match Skills, Match Territory, Time Windows, Resource Availability) and Service Objectives (soft weighted constraints: ASAP, Minimize Travel, Preferred Resource). Global, In-Day, and Resource Schedule Optimization (RSO).
- Field Service Mobile: Offline-first architecture, Prime sync engine, Briefcase Builder data filtering, and offline LWC Mobile Flows.

name: OmniStudio
description: OmniScripts, FlexCards, Data Mappers (DataRaptor) & Integration Procedures
architecturalStandards: Guided User Interactions (OmniScript), Micro-UIs (FlexCards), Data Mappers (Extract, Turbo, Load, Transform), Server-side Orchestration (Integration Procedures)
instructions:
OmniStudio: Official OmniStudio Architecture & Best Practices.
- OmniScript: Guided UI step-by-step flows, formula evaluation, conditional element display, multi-language support, custom LWC override capabilities.
- FlexCard: Contextual modular cards, event-driven architecture (PubSub, Custom Events), conditional states, flyouts, and responsive grid layouts.
- Data Mappers (formerly DataRaptor): Extract (queries multi-object relational data into JSON), Turbo Extract (high-performance single-object query without transforms), Load (upserts JSON payloads into multiple Salesforce objects resolving foreign keys), and Transform (restructures in-memory JSON without DB queries).
- Integration Procedures (IP): Server-side orchestration engine executing multiple Data Mappers, HTTP actions, and Apex in a single server trip. Implements Session Cache, Org Cache, execution chaining, and structured error handling.

name: Marketing Cloud (SFMC)
description: Journey Builder, Automation Studio, Data Extensions, AMPscript & Contact Builder
architecturalStandards: Contact Builder Relational Data Model (Data Designer), Event-driven Journeys, Automation Studio ETL (SQL Activities), AMPscript / SSJS Personalization
instructions:
Marketing Cloud (SFMC): Official Marketing Cloud Architecture & Standards.
- Data Architecture: Standard, Filtered, and Sendable Data Extensions, All Subscribers list, Subscriber Key primary identifier, Contact Builder Data Designer (1:1, 1:N, N:N cardinality).
- Journey Builder: Real-time, event-triggered customer journeys. Entry Sources (Data Extension, API Event, Salesforce Data Event via MC Connect, CloudPages Form), Decision Splits, Engagement Splits, Wait Activities, and Exit Criteria.
- Automation Studio: Scheduled multi-step batch processing engine. Activities include SQL Query Activities (T-SQL queries), Import File, File Transfer, Data Extract, and Send Email.
- Scripting & Personalization: AMPscript (server-side language for emails, landing pages, SMS using Lookup(), LookupRows(), v(), RowCount()), Server-Side JavaScript (SSJS for complex array handling and API calls), and CloudPages.
- Marketing Cloud Connect: Syncs CRM Contacts, Leads, Accounts, and custom objects into Synchronized Data Extensions via the Streaming API.

name: Commerce Cloud (B2B & D2C)
description: B2B/D2C on Core, Storefronts, Cart, Checkout, Order Summary & SCAPI
architecturalStandards: LWR Storefront Architecture, Cart & Checkout Execution Flow, Asynchronous Apex Checkout Integrations (Tax, Shipping, Payment Gateway), Headless SCAPI
instructions:
Commerce Cloud (B2B & D2C on Core): Official Salesforce Commerce Architecture.
- Storefronts: Built natively on the Core Platform with Lightning Web Runtime (LWR) for high-speed edge delivery or Headless via Salesforce Commerce API (SCAPI).
- Product Data Model: WebStore, ProductCatalog, ProductCategory, Standard/Custom Pricebook2, BuyerGroup (bundles BuyerAccounts, Pricebooks, Entitlement Policies, and Promotions).
- Cart & Checkout: WebCart, CartItem, CartDeliveryGroup. Checkout Flows integrate modular Apex checkout subflows via asynchronous Checkout API interfaces: Tax Calculation (sfdc_checkout.CartTaxCalculations), Shipping Calculation (sfdc_checkout.CartShippingCharges), and Payment Gateway Adapter (sfdc_checkout.PaymentGatewayAdapter).
- Order Management (SOM): Transition from WebCart to Order, then OrderSummary, OrderItemSummary, OrderDeliveryGroupSummary, and FulfillmentOrder with automated state machine processing.

name: B2C Commerce (SFCC / Demandware)
description: SFRA, OCAPI, SCAPI, Page Designer, Business Manager & Cartridges
architecturalStandards: Storefront Reference Architecture (SFRA), Open Commerce API (OCAPI), SCAPI, Cartridge Hierarchy, Server-side JavaScript Controllers, dw.* Script API
instructions:
B2C Commerce Cloud (SFCC / Demandware): Official SFCC Enterprise Architecture.
- Framework & Architecture: Storefront Reference Architecture (SFRA) MVC pattern (Models, Views, Controllers). Cartridge Path resolution order where higher-order cartridges override base cartridges (`app_storefront_base`).
- Server Scripting: JavaScript Controllers (`server.get()`, `server.post()`), Middleware chains, ISML (Information Storage Markup Language) templating, and native `dw.*` Script APIs (`dw.order.BasketMgr`, `dw.catalog.ProductMgr`, `dw.customer.CustomerMgr`).
- APIs & Headless: SCAPI (Salesforce Commerce API) REST endpoints for headless commerce; OCAPI (Open Commerce API - Shop and Data APIs) with granular client ID authorization and hook extensions.
- Merchandising & CMS: Business Manager, Page Designer custom components, Content Slots, Source Codes, and Dynamic Price Books.

name: Automotive Cloud
description: Vehicle, Asset, Fleet, Telematics Data Cloud, Claims, Warranties & Dealer Mgmt
architecturalStandards: Automotive Data Model, Connected Vehicle Telematics Ingestion (Data Cloud), Dealer Management System (DMS) Integration, Vehicle Lifecycle Management
instructions:
Automotive Cloud: Official Salesforce Automotive Architecture & Standards.
- Vehicle Lifecycle: Vehicle (VIN, make, model, odometer, transmission, engine), VehicleDefinition (specifications, trim levels, parts catalog), Asset hierarchy, and Fleet tracking.
- Connected Vehicle & Telematics: Real-time telemetry ingestion via Data Cloud Data Streams (speed, engine temperature, battery health, DTC fault codes) driving proactive Agentforce service alerts.
- Customer & Stakeholder Network: PartyRoleRelation modeling multi-party relationships across Owners, Drivers, Dealers, Financiers, and Insurers.
- Warranties & Claims: WarrantyTerm, ProductWarrantyTerm, FaultCode, Claim, and ClaimCoverage with automated adjudication rules and reimbursement settlement flows.

name: Certinia PSA (PS Cloud)
description: Projects, Milestones, Resource Requests, Assignments, Time/Expense, Actuals & Billing
architecturalStandards: RPG Hierarchy (Region, Practice, Group), 3-Layer Access Control (Licenses, Perm Sets, Permission Controls), Transaction/Actuals Ledger, Billing Event Generation
instructions:
Certinia PSA (PS Cloud): Official Architecture & Enterprise Best Practices.
- Organizational Structure: 4 RPG Objects (Region, Practice, Group) organizing resources, projects, and rate cards. Time Periods (Annual, Quarterly, Monthly, Weekly) for financials and forecasting.
- 3-Layer Access Control: (1) Package Licenses (Certinia PSA), (2) Permission Sets (standard/custom personas), (3) Permission Controls (granular record-level overrides for Staffing, Timecard Approval, Expense Approval, Invoicing, Billing).
- Resource Management: Resource Requests (`pse__Resource_Request__c`), Intelligent Staffing, Resource Optimizer, Work Opportunities Hub. Assignments (`pse__Assignment__c`) with Schedules (`pse__Schedule__c`) defining daily billable/non-billable hours.
- Project Management: Projects (`pse__Proj__c`), Milestones (`pse__Milestone__c`), Project Tasks, baseline tracking, and EVA (Earned Value Analysis).
- Financial Engine: Timecards (`pse__Timecard_Header__c`) and Expense Reports (`pse__Expense_Report__c`) post to Transactions (`pse__Transaction__c`) and update Actuals. Billing Event Generation creates `pse__Billing_Event__c` records ready for invoicing and ERP/FFA integration.
- Backlog & Utilization: Historical and scheduled utilization calculations across billable, creditable, and non-billable time classifications.

name: Certinia Services CPQ / Estimator
description: Pre-sales Services Estimates, Rate Cards, Margin Modeling, SOW & PSA Handoff
architecturalStandards: Pre-Sales Scoping & Margin Engineering, Multi-Currency Rate Modeling, Direct Opportunity-to-Estimate Integration, Automated Project Handoff into PSA
instructions:
Certinia Services CPQ / Estimator: Official Pre-Sales Architecture.
- Scoping & Estimation: Estimates (`pse__Estimate__c`) linked directly to Opportunities, defining service deliverable templates, milestone schedules, and task decompositions.
- Pricing & Margin Engineering: Role Requests (`pse__Role_Request__c`) and Rate Cards (`pse__Rate_Card__c`) dynamically calculating cost rates, bill rates, target margins, discounts, and blended hourly rates.
- SOW & Quote Generation: Seamless export of structured deliverable timelines and milestone payment terms into customer-facing Statements of Work (SOW).
- PSA Handoff: One-click handoff converting approved pre-sales Estimates into production PSA Projects (`pse__Proj__c`), creating initial Milestones, Budgets, and unheld Resource Requests automatically.

name: Certinia Accounting (FFA)
description: General Ledger, Accounts Receivable/Payable, Invoicing, Cash Matching & Journals
architecturalStandards: Double-Entry Bookkeeping Ledger on Salesforce, Multi-Company & Multi-Currency Architecture, Automated Billing Event-to-Invoice Integration, Revenue Recognition
instructions:
Certinia Accounting (FinancialForce FFA): Official Financial Architecture.
- Multi-Company Structure: Virtual companies (`codaCompany__c`), multi-currency ledgers, intercompany transactions with automated balancing journal entries.
- Accounts Receivable (AR): Sales Invoices (`codaInvoice__c`) and Credit Notes. Direct programmatic transformation from PSA Billing Events (`pse__Billing_Event__c`) to Sales Invoices via `pse.APIBillingService`.
- Accounts Payable (AP): Purchase Invoices (`codaPurchaseInvoice__c`), matching Purchase Orders, and vendor payment disbursement.
- Cash Matching & Banking: Cash Entries (`codaCashEntry__c`), bank reconciliation, and automated cash matching algorithms clearing invoices against payments.
- General Ledger: Chart of Accounts, Dimension 1-4 analysis tags, journal postings, and real-time trial balance reporting.

name: nCino (Cloud Banking)
description: Commercial & Retail Lending, Loan Origination (LOS), Collateral, Spreads & Credit
architecturalStandards: nCino Bank Operating System (BOS), Commercial & Small Business Lending Lifecycle, Automated Spreading Engine, Credit Memo Generation & Underwriting Rules
instructions:
nCino Cloud Banking: Official nCino Bank Operating System Architecture.
- Product Package & Loans: Top-level deal container (`LLC_BI__Product_Package__c`) grouping multiple credit facilities (`LLC_BI__Loan__c`) for a relationship.
- Entity Involvement: Borrowers, Co-Signers, Guarantors, and Beneficial Owners connected via `LLC_BI__Legal_Entities__c` to enforce Know Your Customer (KYC) and Anti-Money Laundering (AML).
- Collateral Management: Pledged assets (`LLC_BI__Collateral__c`), lien positions, valuations, advance rates, and collateral-to-loan allocations.
- Financial Spreading: Automated spreading engine (`LLC_BI__Spread__c`) capturing balance sheets, income statements, and cash flows to calculate DSCR, DTI, leverage, and liquidity ratios.
- Credit Underwriting: Automated Decision Engine, Risk Rating matrices, Covenant tracking, Document Manager, and automated Credit Memo generation.

name: Financial Services Cloud (FSC)
description: Wealth Mgmt, Retail Banking, Household/ARC Data Model, Compliant Data Sharing
architecturalStandards: Actionable Relationship Center (ARC), Household Group Model, Compliant Data Sharing (CDS) Object-Level Governance, Client 360 Wealth Management
instructions:
Financial Services Cloud (FSC): Official Financial Services Architecture.
- Household Model: Person Account or Individual (Contact + Account) aggregated into Household Group Accounts with primary group flags and dynamic rollups.
- Actionable Relationship Center (ARC): Interactive graphical tree visualizing complex legal entities, trusts, family members, and business affiliations.
- Financial Accounts: Bank accounts, investment portfolios, insurance policies, and mortgages modeled in `FinServ__FinancialAccount__c` with rollups to Household total net worth.
- Compliant Data Sharing (CDS): Granular participant-based sharing rules ensuring sensitive client financial data is restricted to authorized deal teams without altering OWD.
- Interaction Summaries: Structured meeting note capture with integrated compliance review, participant assignment, and mobile sync.

name: Health Cloud
description: HL7 FHIR R4 Model, Care Plans, Clinical Data, EHR, Provider Directory & IDA
architecturalStandards: HL7 FHIR R4 Alignment, Patient 360 Architecture, Intelligent Document Automation (IDA), Health Cloud Provider Search & Credentialing
instructions:
Health Cloud: Official Healthcare & Life Sciences Architecture.
- Clinical Data Model: Standard FHIR R4 aligned objects including EhrObservation, EhrCondition, EhrEncounter, MedicationStatement, and AllergyIntolerance.
- Patient 360 & Care Plans: Unified Patient record (Person Account), customizable Care Plans (CarePlan object based on Case), Care Plan Templates, Goals, and CareTeamMembers.
- Provider Management: Provider Directory (HealthcareProvider, HealthcareFacility, HealthcareProviderFacility), NPI tracking, specialty taxonomies, and sub-second Provider Search.
- Intelligent Document Automation (IDA): OCR ingestion of faxes and medical records directly into patient charts using AWS Textract or Einstein Document Reader.
- Compliance: HIPAA, HITRUST, Shield Platform Encryption, and Audit Trail integration.

name: Manufacturing Cloud
description: Sales Agreements, Account Forecasting, Rebates, Warranty Lifecycle & Asset Service
architecturalStandards: Run-Rate Runoff vs Spot Sales Modeling, Advanced Account Forecasting (Data Processing Engine), Volume Rebate Management, Asset & Warranty Service Lifecycle
instructions:
Manufacturing Cloud: Official Manufacturing Cloud Architecture.
- Sales Agreements: Long-term run-rate contract tracking (`SalesAgreement`, `SalesAgreementProduct`, `SalesAgreementProductSchedule`). Quantities and prices scheduled across multiple terms (monthly, quarterly), tracking Planned vs Actual vs Forecasted values.
- Advanced Account Forecasting: Real-time, multi-dimensional forecast generation powered by Data Processing Engine (DPE) batch jobs incorporating sales agreements, pipeline opportunities, past orders, and market indicators.
- Rebate Management: Volume-based and tier-based incentive programs (`RebateProgram`, `RebateProgramMember`) with automated payout calculations.
- Warranty & Service Operations: Complete warranty tracking, claims capture, and replacement workflows for manufactured machinery and parts.

name: Revenue Cloud (Billing & Subscriptions)
description: Salesforce Billing, Invoicing, Payments, Credit/Debit Notes & RevRec (ASC 606)
architecturalStandards: Quote-to-Revenue Architecture, Automated Invoice Schedulers, ASC 606 / IFRS 15 Revenue Recognition, Payment Gateway Integration, Usage-based Invoicing
instructions:
Revenue Cloud (Salesforce Billing & Subscriptions): Official Architecture.
- Order Execution: Contracted CPQ Orders activate into Billing-ready line items with Bill Through Dates, Billing Schedules, and Tax Treatments.
- Invoicing: Automated Invoice Schedulers batch generate Invoices (`blng__Invoice__c`) and Invoice Lines. Supports Bill in Advance, Bill in Arrears, Milestones, and Usage rating.
- Payments & Adjustments: Payment processing via Payment Gateway Adapters (Stripe, CyberSource), Payment Allocation, Credit Notes (`blng__CreditNote__c`), and Debit Notes.
- Revenue Recognition: ASC 606 / IFRS 15 compliant Revenue Recognition Rules and Treatments creating Revenue Schedules (`blng__RevenueSchedule__c`) tracking amortized vs deferred revenue.

name: Public Sector Solutions (PSS)
description: Licensing & Permitting, Inspections, Grants, Benefit Management & BRE
architecturalStandards: OmniStudio Guided Citizen Portals, Business Rules Engine (BRE) Decision Matrix Architecture, Inspection & Enforcement Execution, Benefit Disbursement
instructions:
Public Sector Solutions (PSS / Government Cloud): Official Architecture.
- Licensing & Permitting: Citizen self-service applications (BusinessLicenseApplication, IndividualApplication) orchestrated through OmniStudio OmniScripts.
- Business Rules Engine (BRE): Complex policy, fee, and eligibility decision matrices executing declarative lookup and calculation algorithms.
- Inspections & Enforcement: Inspection assessment execution on mobile, violation logging, and compliance re-inspection workflows.
- Grants & Benefit Management: BenefitProgram definition, applicant eligibility evaluation, BenefitAssignment, and scheduled payment disbursements.

name: Education Cloud (EDA)
description: Education Data Architecture (EDA), Student Success, Admissions & Programs
architecturalStandards: Education Data Architecture (EDA), Administrative vs Academic Program Account Hierarchy, Student Success Hub (SSH), Appointment Scheduling
instructions:
Education Cloud & EDA: Official Higher-Ed & K-12 Architecture.
- EDA Data Architecture: Account-to-Account Affiliations (`hed__Affiliation__c`), Contact-to-Contact Relationships (`hed__Relationship__c`), Administrative Account model.
- Academic Operations: Terms (`hed__Term__c`), Courses, Course Offerings, and Course Connections (`hed__Course_Connection__c` modeling Student vs Faculty roles).
- Recruitment & Admissions: Applicant journey tracking, lead conversion to applicant, document verification, and decision management.
- Student Success Hub (SSH): Holistic 360 view of students, early alert flags, success teams, and appointment scheduling.

name: Nonprofit Cloud (NPSP)
description: NPSP & Unified Cloud, Fundraising, Donations, Grants, Recurring Giving & GAU
architecturalStandards: Household Account Model, Soft Credits & Partial Soft Credits, General Accounting Unit (GAU) Allocations, Automated Recurring Donation Management
instructions:
Nonprofit Cloud & NPSP: Official Philanthropy Architecture.
- Household Model: Automatic 1:1 grouping of contacts into Household Accounts with automated formal greeting, informal greeting, and household naming rollups.
- Donation & Revenue Engine: Opportunities representing Donations, Grants, Major Gifts, and Matching Gifts. Automated GAU Allocations (`npsp__Allocation__c`) directing revenue to designated accounting funds.
- Recurring Donations: `npsp__Recurring_Donation__c` orchestrating fixed or open-ended recurring gift installments with automated card updater and pledge tracking.
- Relationship & Soft Credits: Contact-to-Contact relationships, automated Opportunity Contact Roles, and Partial Soft Credits recognizing non-donor influencers.

name: Consumer Goods Cloud
description: Retail Execution, Store Audits, Planograms, Promotions, DSD & Field Reps
architecturalStandards: Retail Execution Lifecycle, Planogram Compliance with Einstein Vision, In-Store Assessment Workflows, Direct Store Delivery (DSD)
instructions:
Consumer Goods Cloud: Official Retail Architecture.
- Retail Network: RetailStore hierarchies, StoreAssortments, and Preferred Visit time windows for field sales representatives.
- Visit Execution: Scheduled and ad-hoc Visits. AssessmentTasks orchestrating Inventory Audits, Promotion Checks, Out-of-Stock audits, and Order Generation.
- Planogram Compliance: Einstein Vision AI checking shelf share and product facings against target planograms via mobile photos.
- Direct Store Delivery (DSD): Route optimization, van inventory reconciliation, delivery verification, and payment collection at store backdoors.

name: Net Zero Cloud
description: Carbon Accounting, Scope 1, 2, 3 GHG Emissions, ESG Compliance & Auditing
architecturalStandards: Greenhouse Gas (GHG) Protocol Scope 1-3 Compliance, Automated Emissions Factor Mapping, Materiality Assessments, SEC/CSRD Audit Trail Governance
instructions:
Net Zero Cloud: Official Sustainability Architecture.
- Carbon Inventory: Capturing utility bills and fuel logs via Stationary Asset Energy Use and Vehicle Energy Use records.
- GHG Scope 1, 2, 3: Scope 1 (direct fuel combustion), Scope 2 (purchased electricity using location-based and market-based methods), Scope 3 (value chain emissions across procurement, business travel, and logistics).
- Emissions Factor Engine: Automated calculation engine multiplying consumption metrics (kWh, gallons, therms) by regional government/EPA emissions factors.
- ESG Disclosures: Auditable reporting compliant with CSRD, SEC Climate Disclosures, CDP, and TCFD frameworks.
